architecture.mechanism: Electrical breakdown of air limits charge accumulation on insulating surfaces, which can be mitigated by altering environmental pressure or humidity to prevent discharge events.
architecture.intervention: Install localized desiccant packs or sealed gaskets around the Sentra's door latch actuators and remote receiver modules to maintain low-humidity microenvironments that suppress air breakdown and stabilize triboelectric potentials on internal insulators.
architecture.expected_effect: Prevention of intermittent signal loss and component failure caused by electrostatic discharge events triggered by humidity-dependent air breakdown within the door assembly.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the vehicle's remote entry system in a controlled chamber cycling between 10% and 90% relative humidity; if the intervention is effective, failure rates will remain constant across the humidity range, whereas untreated units will show increased failure rates at high humidity.
